title: Tune cursor follower visual style
context: Improve cursor follower polish by making the trail a bit slower and softer, increasing blur/size slightly, and improving visibility in light mode while preserving dark mode readability.

tasks.title: Tune cursor follower size, blur, and theme contrast
acceptance_criteria: Cursor follower visual size is increased slightly
Cursor follower blur/glow is increased slightly
Trail feel is tuned by slowing transform animation for a softer follow
Light theme follower uses explicit stronger visibility declarations (background 68%, blur 1.5px, larger glow)
Dark theme follower uses explicit balanced visibility declarations (background 50%, blur 1.3px, controlled glow)
Focused tests assert the updated style declarations
npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/CursorFollower.spec.ts src/__tests__/App.spec.ts, npm run type-check, and npm run build-only all pass
